source_review: Shared aggregate preserves the former reference row predicates and now applies them to certificate verification before nullable min/max can hide malformed metadata. Explicit null predicates remain on scores/iterations/converged and required residuals.

Post-convergence uniform iteration/residual and residual-bound checks follow NonConvergedError; nonconvergence stays distinct from answer mismatch. Optional all-null baseline residuals and optimized zero iterations remain supported.
Vertex-domain, nonnegative finite score, reference-vector score and fixed-point residual proof paths remain in place; this change is metadata validation, not a new PageRank algorithm.

Only candidate02 source delta is fixture-side statistics disabling plus explicit NaN readback. Existing rejection assertions are unchanged; the readback guard has a distinct message so it cannot satisfy the score-rejection assertion.

Default-statistics NaN substitution and initial failing gate/receipt-finalization outcomes remain separately recorded. The successful no-statistics baseline directly observes NaN and rejects it under both previous policies; metadata certificate gaps remain reproducible.

gate_review.scope: Python benchmark suite plus actual local SQL/Parquet on pinned installed Sail 0.7.0. No candidate runtime build, distributed or performance verdict.

limits: Read-only review; no suite rerun, workload, remote-host call or source edit by reviewer.
Gate validates Python benchmark validators using the pinned installed Sail0.7.0 local SQL/Parquet runtime. It does not build candidate Rust runtime or qualify cluster/performance behavior.
